# Taiwan Garbage Truck Map — MCP Server

> Read-only Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for garbage and recycling truck stops, routes, and arrival times in Taipei, New Taipei, Taichung, and Kaohsiung (Taiwan). No authentication required. All times are in `Asia/Taipei` local time.

## Connect

- [MCP endpoint](https://mcp.garbage.yukai.dev/mcp): Streamable HTTP, stateless. Supports MCP protocol versions `2025-11-25`, `2025-06-18`, and `2025-03-26`.
- [Server Card](https://mcp.garbage.yukai.dev/mcp/server-card): `application/mcp-server-card+json`, for pre-connection discovery.
- [AI Catalog](https://mcp.garbage.yukai.dev/.well-known/ai-catalog.json): domain-level agent discovery.
- Client config: `{ "mcpServers": { "taipei-trash": { "url": "https://mcp.garbage.yukai.dev/mcp" } } }`. For stdio-only clients: `npx mcp-remote https://mcp.garbage.yukai.dev/mcp`.
- Browser clients: requests with an `Origin` header are rejected (`403`) unless the origin is allow-listed. Native and server-side clients send no `Origin` header.
- Rate limit: 60 requests per minute per IP.

## Tools

- `list_cities`: returns supported cities with IDs (`taipei`, `new-taipei`, `taichung`, `kaohsiung`) and geographic bounding boxes.
- `find_nearby_points`: accepts `lat`, `lng`, optional `radiusMeters` (50–2,000, default 500), `limit` (1–20), and `city`. Returns nearest stops first.
- `search_points`: accepts `city`, `query` (district / village / road / route keywords in Traditional Chinese; all space-separated terms must match), and optional `limit`.
- `get_schedule`: accepts a `pointId` (from `find_nearby_points` or `search_points`) and returns that stop plus all stops on the same route in arrival order.
- Point schema: `id`, `city`, `district`, `village`, `location`, `route`, `arrivalTime`, `departureTime` (`HH:MM`), `latitude`, `longitude`, and—for New Taipei and Taichung—a weekly `schedule` (`collectionType` → ISO weekdays, `1`=Mon … `7`=Sun) plus `servesToday`.
